sections.title: A few things I've built.
sections.lede: 5 projects from my professional and personal work — what the problem was, what I built, and what changed.

items.label: PostTrainLLM — a transformer built end to end, then a local LLM factory
items.title: A small GPT (~0.8M params, byte-level) written from scratch in three layers — a PyTorch reference, a hand-derived C++/WASM implementation, and a full WebGPU training loop — running entirely in a browser tab. Every layer's backward pass was finite-difference checked before being trusted. It has since grown into a Mac-first LLM factory and runtime, where a 4B model distilled from ~99 frontier rollouts scored 100% on a hard multi-turn tool-calling gate.

items.label: Vector-Powered Personalized Feeds
items.title: A home feed that actually learns what you like. Content gets embedded with BERT, ranked by similarity in Milvus, and the user vector keeps updating from live events. Engagement went up 40%.

items.label: Real-Time Market Data Pipeline
items.title: The streaming backbone of a fintech social app. Go services stream live market data through Kafka, and Socket.IO delivers real-time ticks to clients — and it held up while daily users went from 15k to 200k.

items.label: RAG Agents for Support & Learning
items.title: A set of RAG chatbots — support, learning, assistant — built on OpenAI APIs and grounded in real product docs, plus a moderation bot that cut human intervention in support queries by 90%.

items.label: Durable Financial Workflows
items.title: Financial planning can't run on workflows that quietly break. Moving them to Temporal killed 90% of the random failures and gave the team back about three hours a day.
